name: Crystal (United States)
description: Blue field with a white arc sweeping from the lower hoist to the upper fly and a lighter blue area below it, charged with a white fourteen-pointed star for the city's fourteen neighbourhoods.
history: Crystal is a suburban city in Hennepin County, Minnesota, about from downtown Minneapolis. The flag was adopted in 2017 (chosen by the city council and unveiled on 18 March 2017 at the first Crystal Masquerade Ball, according to Flags of the World).

features.role: white arc for the city's transportation and trail systems
lighter blue area below the arc
fourteen-pointed star for the fourteen neighbourhoods
